about: ambientcg's decision table (the P3 procedure). Two lanes: api (ambientcg.com: the v2 search and the download redirect) and media (the ambientCG-Web B2 bucket on acg-download and acg-media). The API only reads: the World's catalog is published through a door.

decisions.demand: the editor's search and its files lookup
decisions.why: a computed read: assets filtered by type and keywords, ordered by the sort, paged by limit and offset, in an envelope of the search's own (searchQuery, numberOfResults, page links)
a computed read: the 302 to the file's name on the download host, or the host's 404 text

decisions.demand: the zip the import extracts, and the thumbnails
decisions.why: a computed read of a published file's bytes with its B2 headers; a name no file has is B2's not_found

decisions.demand: every read above needs a published asset
decisions.why: ambientCG has no publishing API: an asset is published with its zips and its thumbnail
